R1Z.PV_OWN_Laws.AllocDisjoint {S X E : Type}

  (r : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Request) (w : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.State S X) (p q : ℕ) (s : S) (c : R1Z.PV_OWN_Heap.Cell)
  (adequate : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.AllocatorAdequate prim r w)
  (h : prim r w.allocator = (R1Z.PV_W_Threading.Outcome.ok (some p), s)) (old : w.memory.heap q = some c)

  (r : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Request) (owner : ℕ) (w : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.State S X) (s : S)
  (h : prim r w.allocator = (R1Z.PV_W_Threading.Outcome.div, s)) :
  (R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.allocate prim r owner w).world = { memory := w.memory, allocator := s, extra := w.extra }
R1Z.PV_OWN_Laws.AllocFailure {S X E : Type}

  (r : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Request) (owner : ℕ) (w : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.State S X) (s : S) (e : E)
  (h : prim r w.allocator = (R1Z.PV_W_Threading.Outcome.fail e, s)) :

R1Z.PV_OWN_Laws.AllocFresh {S X E : Type}

R1Z.PV_OWN_Laws.AllocGeneration {S X E : Type}

R1Z.PV_OWN_AllocationAbort.null {S X E A : Type}
  (primitive : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Request → S → R1Z.PV_W_Threading.Outcome E (Option ℕ) × S)
  (r : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Request) (owner : ℕ) (abort : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Action S X E A)
  (next : R1Z.PV_OWN_Heap.Token → R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Action S X E A) (w : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.State S X) (s : S)
  (h : primitive r w.allocator = (R1Z.PV_W_Threading.Outcome.ok none, s)) :
  R1Z.PV_OWN_AllocationAbort.request primitive r owner abort next w =
    { outcome := (abort { memory := w.memory, allocator := s, extra := w.extra }).outcome,
      world := (abort { memory := w.memory, allocator := s, extra := w.extra }).world,
      calls :=

          (abort { memory := w.memory, allocator := s, extra := w.extra }).calls }
